title: The Next Episode About the Malwa

blocks.text: Dohra:
After plundering and killing as they returned, Deeply concerned did the Malwa people feel.
Invader (Chattarsal) being related to the Mughal emperor, Lest he should exert pressure on them. (1)
lines: Invader (Chattarsal) being related to the Mughal emperor,
Lest he should exert pressure on them.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

The same issue did the (Malwa) elders debate, As they felt highly concerned about it. They would not survive even if they deserted the region, As it was surrounded by the Mughal rule from all sides. (2)
lines: The same issue did the (Malwa) elders debate,
As they felt highly concerned about it.
They would not survive even if they deserted the region,
As it was surrounded by the Mughal rule from all sides.

blocks.text: (At this), Baba Mohan proposed to approach Delhi emperor, Through some rustic maneuver would he appease the king. Promising to make an offering of one hundred and a quarter rupees, With folded hands did he pray to God (for success). (3)
lines: (At this),
Baba Mohan proposed to approach Delhi emperor,
Through some rustic maneuver would he appease the king.
Promising to make an offering of one hundred and a quarter rupees,
With folded hands did he pray to God (for success).

blocks.text: Arranging to offer a horse as tribute to the king, Such a strategy did he resolve to adopt. Thereupon, a Sikh did arrive and remarked, An earring for the emperor's ear should he take along. (4)
lines: Arranging to offer a horse as tribute to the king,
Such a strategy did he resolve to adopt.
Thereupon, a Sikh did arrive and remarked,
An earring for the emperor's ear should he take along.

blocks.text: Such a present would he take to the king, If he thought there was some worth in the Sikh's suggestion. Thus did he proceed after making a prayer, These tributes did he offer after reaching the Delhi court. (5)
lines: Such a present would he take to the king,
If he thought there was some worth in the Sikh's suggestion.
Thus did he proceed after making a prayer,
These tributes did he offer after reaching the Delhi court.

blocks.text: Dohra:
Thus did he submit a petition to the king, Making an offering of a horse and an earring. For slaughtering poor people he (Chattarsal) had gone, (But) himself did he perish in the attempt. (6)
lines: Thus did he submit a petition to the king,
Making an offering of a horse and an earring.
For slaughtering poor people he (Chattarsal) had gone,
(But) himself did he perish in the attempt.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

The moment the emperor looked at the earring, Happily did he offer to his dear queen to please her. What would she do with a single earring, said the queen, A pair of earrings together could she put on her ears. (7)
lines: The moment the emperor looked at the earring,
Happily did he offer to his dear queen to please her.
What would she do with a single earring, said the queen,
A pair of earrings together could she put on her ears.

blocks.text: Calling Baba Mohan the emperor instructed him sternly, Must he produce the other earring if he wished to survive. Highly would he be rewarded if he brought the other earring, Instantly would he be killed if he failed in his attempt. (8)
lines: Calling Baba Mohan the emperor instructed him sternly,
Must he produce the other earring if he wished to survive.
Highly would he be rewarded if he brought the other earring,
Instantly would he be killed if he failed in his attempt.

blocks.text: Hearing this, highly alarmed did Baba Mohan feel, His whole clan would be wiped out if he failed to find the other ring. Once again did he vow to make an offering to the Guru, An offering of full five hundred rupees would he offer on a salver. (9)
lines: Hearing this, highly alarmed did Baba Mohan feel,
His whole clan would be wiped out if he failed to find the other ring.
Once again did he vow to make an offering to the Guru,
An offering of full five hundred rupees would he offer on a salver.

blocks.text: One of Mohan's uncles who had accompanied him to Delhi, Thoroughly did he brief his uncle about the other earring. The other earring must be lying somewhere around, The spot where the (invading) Chattarsal had died. (10)
lines: One of Mohan's uncles who had accompanied him to Delhi,
Thoroughly did he brief his uncle about the other earring.
The other earring must be lying somewhere around,
The spot where the (invading) Chattarsal had died.

blocks.text: Dohra:

If it be their good luck by the Guru's grace, Surely would they be able to trace the lost earring. If they failed to find out the other ornament, Definitely would the emperor eliminate their whole clan. (11)
lines: If it be their good luck by the Guru's grace,
Surely would they be able to trace the lost earring.
If they failed to find out the other ornament,
Definitely would the emperor eliminate their whole clan.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

Must his uncle enquire from all the people, Lest anyone of them should have found the earring. Solemnly did Baba Mohan give an undertaking to the king, His sons would surely bring the lost earring. (12)
lines: Must his uncle enquire from all the people,
Lest anyone of them should have found the earring.
Solemnly did Baba Mohan give an undertaking to the king,
His sons would surely bring the lost earring.

blocks.text: As they were making a thorough search for the earring, God fortune did smile upon them at that moment. They picked it up the moment they spotted the earring, With gift as precious as life did they reach the court. (13)
lines: As they were making a thorough search for the earring,
God fortune did smile upon them at that moment.
They picked it up the moment they spotted the earring,
With gift as precious as life did they reach the court.

blocks.text: Immediately as they presented the ornament to the king, Highly benevolent did the Mughal emperor appear. Asking Baba Mohan for getting a landed territory, A lease deed for one lakh acres did the emperor sign. With revered Guru's grace did this event happen, Highly delighted did Baba Mohan and his uncle feel. (14)
lines: Immediately as they presented the ornament to the king,
Highly benevolent did the Mughal emperor appear.
Asking Baba Mohan for getting a landed territory,
A lease deed for one lakh acres did the emperor sign.
With revered Guru's grace did this event happen,
Highly delighted did Baba Mohan and his uncle feel.
